object_description: sequence of separate school volumes around shared courtyards
design_condition: Separate volumes are arranged along the principal square and around shared outdoor spaces, with the gymnasium partly sunk into the ground and a later primary-school building extending into the park.

positive.statement: The basic urban-planning situation is clear and well suited to school operations.

position.rationale: Separate volumes and courtyard arrangement are clearly visible across all calibrated views.

positive.statement: The separate structures create positive outdoor spaces at different levels with good connections to the square and park.

position.rationale: Open spaces are inferred between separated masses, with elevations indicating varied levels.

positive.statement: The differentiated building depths are well adapted to the uses.

position.rationale: Top and elevation views show distinct narrow and deeper volume profiles.

positive.statement: The close connection of the elementary school to the two playgrounds is ideal for school operations.

position.rationale: A school volume and adjacent open areas are approximated from the separated massing.

positive.statement: The visual connection to the square and partly recessed gymnasium supports animation and social control after school hours.

position.rationale: The east-side volume and low-level mass are used as approximate square-facing gymnasium locations.

positive.statement: The arrangement of public spaces in the public building area and private classrooms in the deeper building is logical.

position.target: public building area and deeper classrooms
position.rationale: Public and deeper-use distinctions are not explicit, so the central deeper mass is an approximate anchor.

positive.statement: The daycare layout provides a good overview, short distances and an original additional level of quiet rooms.

position.rationale: The multi-level east-side volume provides the most plausible daycare anchor.

positive.statement: The project takes a careful and convincing approach to the historically significant existing building.

position.rationale: The outer west-side volume is used as an approximate existing-building location.

positive.statement: The project is classified as cost-effective overall.

position.rationale: Cost judgment has no useful spatial referent.

negative.statement: The second-stage primary-school structure is not yet convincing as either a primary school or a volume in the park.

position.rationale: The isolated lower-right volume is clearly distinguishable in the top view and elevations.

negative.statement: The relationship between the kindergarten units and their outdoor spaces is not yet sufficiently formulated.

position.rationale: Unit-to-yard relationships are interior and approximated around the east-side mass.

negative.statement: The proposed relocation floor plan is schematic and unconvincing in its internal and external references.

position.rationale: The west-side building is a directional approximation for the referenced relocation plan.

negative.statement: A required equipment room is missing from the sports facilities.

position.rationale: Sports facilities are approximated at the low-level east-side volume; the room is not distinguishable.

negative.statement: The force transmission through the thermal insulation leads to numerous thermal bridges and requires revision for execution.

position.rationale: The comment concerns the exterior envelope, approximated on the prominent east-side façades.

negative.statement: The narrow axial dimensions result in a large number of solar-shading elements.

position.rationale: Repeated elevation lines indicate façade elements on the taller east-side volume.
